area: player-data safety: ProfileStore.save broke its bool contract on one path (fixed), and all failure modes are now pinned

find.report_claim: shooter/profile.py documents save(self, profile) -> bool and the game's _save_profile relies on it, catching OSError to raise 'PROFILE NOT SAVED' in the debrief rather than crashing the finish
find.live_evidence: probing four failure modes showed three correct -- corrupt file without backup is quarantined and reset, corrupt file with a backup recovers best_score 777, a fresh lock refuses the save and writes nothing -- but a path whose PARENT could not be created (a file where the directory should be) raised FileExistsError out of save()
find.consumer_evidence: the traceback pinned it to _acquire_lock: self.path.parent.mkdir(...) sat outside any try, so the exception escaped before save's own try block began; the game survived only because _save_profile also catches OSError, which means any other caller trusting the -> bool signature would not

killed: fixing it in the game instead of the store: the broken contract belongs to ProfileStore, and every future caller would inherit the bug
catching the exception inside save() only: mkdir runs in _acquire_lock, before the write try block, so the guard has to live there
weakening the test to 'does not crash': the contract is `is False`, not 'returns something falsy'
analyze.survivor: wrap the mkdir in _acquire_lock so an unusable parent reports no-lock, and pin every failure mode including the regression

fix.shooter: shooter/profile.py wraps self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) in try/except OSError returning None, so save() returns False for an uncreatable parent; tests/test_profile_safety.py (13 tests) covers that regression, round-trip plus .bak contents, quarantining a corrupt file without touching it, backup recovery, fresh-lock refusal without a partial write, stale-lock takeover and release, no lock left behind after repeated saves, five junk payloads all loading as usable profiles, and the game reporting PROFILE NOT SAVED while keeping last_run

shooter.existing_profile_suites: 21 passed in 3.83s (recovery, save retry, history, win history, backup restart, save error)
shooter.mutation: reverting the mkdir guard reproduced the exact failure ('FileExistsError: [WinError 183] ... notadir') and failed only test_save_returns_false_when_the_parent_cannot_be_created; shooter/profile.py restored byte-identically (sha256 match).
